name: Mars Polar Lander

locations.label: Ultimi Scopuli, South Polar Layered Terrain

summary: Mars Polar Lander was an ambitious robotic probe sent to study the Martian south pole.
hook: Contact was lost during my atmospheric descent into the southern polar terrain of Mars in 1999.
how_it_worked: Designed to use thrusters to touch down softly on layered polar deposits and analyze soil ice.
science: Highlighted the critical need for continuous telemetry during off-world atmospheric descent and landing.

facts.text: Telemetry was lost seconds before atmospheric entry, leading NASA to redesign landing monitoring for all future missions.
Carried two microprobes designed to penetrate the surface soil upon high-speed impact.

image.alt: Mars Polar Lander awaiting testing at Kennedy Space Center before launch
